featured_reviews.name: Shreya Jha
featured_reviews.review_text: I got a few custom pieces of furniture designed at Elegance Interiors including a sectional sofa bed and a study desk. featured_reviews.review_text: Nice job,  professional,  lovely furniture , prices were just right. Feroz was a nice and calm gentleman. Have my things as promised

featured_reviews.name: PK Kurian
featured_reviews.review_text: We have been dealing with Feroz for over a decade, and he has crafted all our furniture—both new and old—with exceptional skill and attention to detail. He is courteous, creative, and extremely dependable. What truly sets him apart is his ability to understand the customer's requirements and deliver exactly what he promises. The quality of his work is consistently excellent, and he is supported by a dedicated team that ensures timely and precise execution. Highly recommended for anyone seeking reliable and high-quality craftsmanship.

featured_reviews.name: Elizabeth Kurian
featured_reviews.review_text: We have known Feroz for over 10 years. He's made almost all our furniture for us, including our wardrobes. He's very courteous, creative,  extremely dependable and his work is of excellent quality. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.review_text:

But more importantly is Mr Shehzad was very cordial and understood are requirement .

featured_reviews.name: Hiraj Counto
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a pleasant experience doing business with Elegance Interiors. They were very helpful in suggesting the right material and alignment for the new sofa. Also the work was completed and delivery was done within the agreed timeline. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a quality job at a reasonable price point.

featured_reviews.name: Aliasgar Rupawalla
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently I bought a chest of drawers from Elegance Interiors. Very professional people. Deliver good products on time. Very smooth experience.

featured_reviews.name: MR Rao
featured_reviews.review_text: It was a pleasure to do business with Mr. Feroz at Elegance Interiors. He is soft spoken, knowledgeable and a thorough gentleman. Thank you Feroz. We wish you all the best.

featured_reviews.name: eureka alphonso
featured_reviews.review_text:
Your one stop shop for home furnishings. They have a very large variety of curated and quality home decor. But if you need curtains, this place should be on your speed dial. They have a full floor dedicated to an extensive range of curtain fabrics. Prices range from economical to astronomical (what ever floats your boat)

The staff is very patient as you glacialy browse through their range. It can seem like forever to find something cause their selection is vast, but the staff knows their way around the place and will be the best guide to help you decide.

Many fabric shops don't let you take a swatch or even a picture of it.. That kind of sucks cause you need to compare and realise it to your actual home. They were courteous enough to lend me their book. I guess this also depends on how comfortable you are with them, so it worked for me but it may not work for you. Once you choose, their stitching is immaculate and delivery is very prompt..i needed it in 4 days and they delivered. I highly recommend them.

featured_reviews.review_text: I am a architect and took my client here for purchasing fabrics for headboards it is a good store with variety, however the prices are a little hiked. Also one needs to check the quality of product before taking final order, because we purchased velvet and it came damaged both times.
